task.title: Registrar source-operation boundaries
task.shortdesc: Cree una operations handoff note que indique runtime user, process model, supported checks y deferred production capabilities.

prereq.p: Las reviews de configuration, storage, backup, network y CORS se completaron para la source-run instance.

context.p: La documentación BPM 0.9.0 Administrator/DevOps actualmente admite source-run operation para controlled evaluation. Aún no proporciona distribution installers, native services, official daemonization, production topology ni operational runbooks completos para cada enterprise control.

step.cmd: Registre runtime user y process model.

info.p: Identifique el shell user propietario del checkout, .venv, data/ y el proceso en ejecución make dev o uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000. No reclame supported service account, systemd unit, Windows service ni restart policy salvo que su external platform los proporcione y los posea.

Incluya source revision, active configuration values, migration status, /health, /health/ready, UI route smoke, API example status, foreground-log review y manual backup evidence. Vincule API evidence a reusable API examples en vez de duplicar endpoint procedures.

step.cmd: Registre deferred capabilities como blockers o external responsibilities.

info.p: Indique que packaged installers, native Linux o Windows services, reverse proxy and TLS recipes, HA clustering, managed secrets, authentication configuration, backup automation, restore orchestration, monitoring dashboards, log rotation y production hardening no son proporcionados por BPM 0.9.0 source documentation.

step.cmd: Adjunte user-facing recovery references sin mover ownership.

info.p: Cuando un operator necesite entender UI symptoms, enlace a user-facing troubleshooting como product connection recovery. Mantenga deployment, API, backup y network ownership en Administrator/DevOps Guide.

result.p: La handoff note declara qué puede soportar el source deployment actual, qué evidence lo prueba y qué production responsibilities quedan fuera de BPM 0.9.0.

postreq.p: Use esta boundary note como punto inicial para el update-from-source runbook y futuras production/HA/reverse-proxy documentation tasks.
